The future benefit of those losses is $7 million and is a reduction in the 2015 income tax provision. The net effect of this event in the 2015 income tax provision is a reduction of $1 million. The Company's operations in Malaysia currently operate under a tax holiday, which will expire in 2018. This tax holiday may be extended if specific conditions are met. The net impact of the tax holiday did not decrease the Company's net loss in 2015 because the Company's operations in Malaysia operated at a net loss. The net impact of tax holidays decreased the Company's net loss by $2 million in 2014, less than $.01 per share, diluted, and decreased the Company's net loss by $1 million in 2013, less than $.01 per share, diluted.
